# NFL Daily — 2026-11-19 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens benched CB Marlon Humphrey for Sunday's game at Carolina after his "criminals" remark about Baltimore — the team's first disciplinary deactivation in more than two decades. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50532199/ravens-send-marlon-humphrey-home-say-inactive)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua was suspended three games for violating the NFL's personal-conduct policy; the ban runs concurrently with his IR stint. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123512902690697610)
- Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson was placed on injured reserve with a knee injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Texans DE Danielle Hunter was ruled out of Thursday night's game against the Colts with a hamstring injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

## Transactions
- Broncos signed CB Riley Moss to a four-year extension through 2030. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50532392/broncos-sign-cb-riley-moss-four-year-extension)

## Injuries
- Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) was limited at Thursday's practice but said he's hopeful to do more Friday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50533151/buccaneers-baker-mayfield-hopes-play-foot-injury)
- Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) was limited Wednesday but said he intends to play Sunday against the Chargers. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-19 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- The Ravens deactivated CB Marlon Humphrey for Sunday's game at Carolina, a day after he apologized for calling Baltimore "best at making criminals" on his podcast; coach Jesse Minter said it's a one-game decision with no fine or suspension announced. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50532199/ravens-send-marlon-humphrey-home-say-inactive)

# Rivals — 2026-11-19 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Browns QB Deshaun Watson said he wants to stay in Cleveland beyond this season and is open to a new deal. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/deshaun-watson-contract-stats-browns-quarterbacks-schedule)
- Steelers LB Patrick Queen is playing through a broken left thumb suffered against the Bengals. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/star-pittsburgh-steelers-linebacker-goes-down-with-thumb-injury.html)
- Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III is questionable for Sunday with a groin injury, putting him in jeopardy of missing a second straight game. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/kansas-city-chiefs-kenneth-walker-injury-emmett-johnson)
- Steelers WRs Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) and Roman Wilson (finger) both increased their practice workload this week, trending toward Sunday against the Eagles. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7793686/2026/11/19/pittsburgh-steelers-wrs-injuries/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Steelers LB Patrick Queen (broken thumb) was a limited practice participant Wednesday but is expected to play through it. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/star-pittsburgh-steelers-linebacker-goes-down-with-thumb-injury.html)
- Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was a full practice participant Thursday, trending toward playing Sunday. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7793686/2026/11/19/pittsburgh-steelers-wrs-injuries/)
- Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is questionable for Sunday after missing practice time this week. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/kansas-city-chiefs-kenneth-walker-injury-emmett-johnson)
- Bills TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) wasn't spotted at Thursday's practice and is questionable for Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
